queries_run: Teledyne Technologies largest customer second source OR in-house 2026
Teledyne customer vertically integrate insourcing instruments 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素揭露：部分客戶已在開發競品或選擇垂直整合，以自家產品取代 Teledyne 產品；國防電子一旦設計導入，客戶要求冗長資格測試才能換供應商。
findings.excerpt: Additionally, some of our customers have been developing competing products or electing to vertically integrate and replace our products with their own.

findings.claim: 投資人簡報摘要稱無單一客戶或國際目的地占銷售超過 5%
findings.excerpt: No single customer or international destination accounts for more than 5% of sales, reducing concentration risk.

customer_second_source.note: 搜尋未找到特定最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製的具名事件；僅有 10-K 一般性風險揭露。投資人簡報摘要稱無單一客戶超過 5% 銷售（二手摘要，未核原文）。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
